_meta.title: Figure 3, Configuration for 3-phase/3-wire systems (see Clauses 4.12.2.1.1, 4.12.3.1 and 4.13)
_meta.note: Phase arrangements per number of conductors per phase (1 to 10), in the order they appear in the figure. Transcribed from the figure and checked against it by the maintainer; not yet signed off by an engineer. Figure notes: (1) neutrals may be added to these configurations; (2) empty circles designate an unused position not occupied by cable.
_meta.grammar: Tiers top to bottom, separated by '/'. A, B, C = phase conductor; '.' = unused position (empty circle in the figure); a leading '+' shifts that tier right by half a pitch (staggered tiers).
